description: List the searches saved with pitchspark_save_search_v1 under the caller's API key, newest first, each with the exact arguments to re-run it ("rerun": tool pitchspark_search_pitches_v3 and its arguments). Use when: the investor asks for their saved searches. Do not use for: running them (pass rerun.arguments to pitchspark_search_pitches_v3). Requires a PitchSpark API key (psk_...). Searches are per key, not per account. Read-only; uses none of the daily pitch allowance.
name: pitchspark_list_saved_searches_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.

title: List your saved searches
